title: Uncovering the action mechanism of Shenqi Tiaoshen formula in the treatment of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease through network pharmacology, molecular docking, and experimental verification.
authors: Qinjun, Yang; Dandan, Yin; Hui, Wang; Yating, Gao; Xinheng, Wang; Di, W U; Jiabing, Tong; Chuanbo, Wang; Zegeng, L I
journal: Journal of traditional Chinese medicine = Chung i tsa chih ying wen pan
one_liner_zh: 该文通过网络药理学、分子对接和实验验证研究中药复方治疗慢阻肺的机制，虽含分子对接但对象为药物-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: OBJECTIVE: To reveal the potential underlying mechanism of the Shenqi Tiaoshen formula (, SQTS) in the treatment of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) by utilizing network pharmacology, molecular docking, and experimental verification. METHODS: Multiple open-source databases and research related to Traditional Chinese Medicine or compounds were employed to screen active ingredients and corresponding potential targets of the SQTS. The protein-protein interaction network screened hub genes, the relevant molecular mechanism and gene regulation were initially identified through the Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes (KEGG) and Gene Ontology (GO) analysis, and molecular docking was used to confirm further the interaction of the main components bound to the core targets. In vivo experiments on the COPD combined Qi-deficiency syndrome rat model were performed to verify the intervention effects and predicted potential molecular mechanisms of the SQTS. RESULTS: This study selected 156 active compounds and 326 candidate targets for treating COPD. Quercetin, Nobiletin, Kaempferol, Luteolin, Ginsenoside Rh2 and Formononetin were probably the main active compounds of SQTS in COPD treatment as they affected the most COPD-related targets, and interleukin-1 (IL-6), signal transducing activator of transcription 3 (STAT3), matrix metalloproteinase-9 (MMP9), vascular endothelial growth factor A (VEGFA), protein kinase B (AKT1), hypoxia-inducible factor-1alpha (HIF-1alpha), and forkhead box O3 (FoxO3) were identified as the hub genes associated with its therapeutic effect. KEGG analysis was mainly enriched in the signaling pathways closely related to inflammation, immunity and oxidative stress, such as HIF-1, tumor necrosis factor (TNF), phosphatidylinositol 3 kinase (PI3K)-AKT, FoxO, apoptosis, IL-17, and toll-like receptor. Molecular docking confirmed that the main active components shared a good affinity with the hub genes. In vivo experiments, the SQTS was found to improve the body weight, exhaustive swimming time, tail-hanging immobility time and struggle times, airway inflammation, lung functions, and inflammatory factors in the rat model of COPD. The up-regulation of p-PI3K, p-AKT, HIF-1alpha, FoxO3alpha, toll like receptor 4, VEGFA, Caspase 3, TNF-alpha, and IL-17 in COPD rats were down-regulated by SQTS, consistent with the network pharmacology results. CONCLUSIONS: This study provides evidence that the SQTS plays a critical role in anti-inflammation via suppressing immune inflammation and oxidative stress related pathways, indicating that the SQTS is a candidate herbal drug for further investigation in treating COPD.
abstract_zh: 目的：通过网络药理学、分子对接和实验验证，揭示参芪调神方（SQTS）治疗慢性阻塞性肺疾病（COPD）的潜在作用机制。方法：利用多个开源数据库及与中药或化合物相关的研究，筛选SQTS的活性成分及相应潜在靶点。通过蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用网络筛选核心基因，借助京都基因与基因组百科全书（KEGG）和基因本体论（GO）分析初步确定相关分子机制和基因调控，并采用分子对接进一步确认主要成分与核心靶点之间的相互作用。在COPD合并气虚证大鼠模型上进行体内实验，以验证SQTS的干预效果及预测的潜在分子机制。结果：本研究筛选出156种活性化合物和326个治疗COPD的候选靶点。槲皮素、川陈皮素、山柰酚、木犀草素、人参皂苷Rh2和芒柄花素可能是SQTS治疗COPD的主要活性化合物，因为它们影响最多的COPD相关靶点，同时白细胞介素-1（IL-6）、信号转导和转录激活因子3（STAT3）、基质金属蛋白酶-9（MMP9）、血管内皮生长因子A（VEGFA）、蛋白激酶B（AKT1）、缺氧诱导因子-1α（HIF-1α）和叉头框蛋白O3（FoxO3）被确定为其治疗作用相关的核心基因。KEGG分析主要富集于与炎症、免疫和氧化应激密切相关的信号通路，如HIF-1、肿瘤坏死因子（TNF）、磷脂酰肌醇3激酶（PI3K）-AKT、FoxO、凋亡、IL-17和Toll样受体。分子对接证实主要活性成分与核心基因具有良好的亲和力。在体内实验中，发现SQTS能改善COPD大鼠模型的体重、力竭游泳时间、悬尾不动时间和挣扎次数、气道炎症、肺功能及炎症因子水平。COPD大鼠中p-PI3K、p-AKT、HIF-1α、FoxO3α、Toll样受体4、VEGFA、Caspase 3、TNF-α和IL-17的上调被SQTS下调，这与网络药理学结果一致。结论：本研究提供证据表明，SQTS通过抑制免疫炎症和氧化应激相关通路在抗炎中发挥关键作用，提示SQTS是进一步研究治疗COPD的候选草药。
